checks.note: The only MCP load path is server.ts:49 registerMcp, which calls scanServer before add(). scanServer covers instructions, prompts, resource templates, and each tool's name, title, description, input and output schemas, and annotations. Native tools are the repo's own code. Only the prompt argument names go unscanned, and prompts never reach the model.

Rules cover control and invisible characters, role overrides and markers, concealment, base64, hex and escaped unicode, URLs, emails, phones, other-server tool names, and length limits. Weakness, not a missing rule: `.{0,40}` does not match newlines, so a multi-line phrasing may evade the override rules.
Server findings return before any add(). Flagged tools go to rejected and only acceptedTools are registered. definitions() is built from the registry only.

checks.quote: this.rejected.push({ serverId, reason: `metadata scan error: ${(err as Error).message}` });
checks.note: A scanner throw returns without registering anything. A catalog failure at server.ts:50 disables the EHR tools. There is no flag that disables scanning.

note: Every MCP metadata field is scanned before registration, flagged items are rejected, and scanner errors fail closed; I found no bypass path.
